title: Severe external bleeding

source.section: How to Stop Bleeding and Applying Direct Pressure

calming_line: Stay calm. Firm pressure is the key step right now.

emergency_call.instruction: Call emergency services now, or put the phone on speaker while you keep helping.

items.label: the cleanest part of the T-shirt
a wide improvised tourniquet at least 2 inches wide

steps.instruction_template: Use {cloth} to apply firm, direct pressure to the bleeding wound.
If blood soaks through, place another layer of {cloth} on top while continuing firm pressure.
steps.condition: Use if blood soaks through the first dressing.

steps.instruction_template: If a hemostatic dressing is available, use it with direct pressure.
steps.condition: Only if a hemostatic dressing is available.

steps.instruction_template: Once the bleeding is controlled, apply a pressure dressing to help keep it stopped.
If life-threatening bleeding from an arm or leg is not controlled by direct pressure, apply {tourniquet} above the wound and tighten it until bleeding stops.
steps.condition: Only for life-threatening arm or leg bleeding that is not controlled by direct pressure.

steps.instruction_template: If an improvised tourniquet is used, it should be at least 2 inches wide.
steps.condition: Only if an improvised tourniquet is used.

do_not_say: Do not suggest pressure points as reliable bleeding control.
Do not tell the user to remove an embedded object.
Do not suggest delaying emergency services when bleeding is severe.
